total_count.description: The total number of items in this list.

OrderBatch.description: An order batch is the primary resource created by the API. Order batches contain an array of orders.

send_status.description: The `pending` status indicates that an order batch is being prepared to be sent out. If it is not scheduled, it is being sent asynchronously. If it is scheduled, it will stay in `pending` state until the scheduled time is reached, at which point it will be processed and moved to `complete`. When it is in `pending` status, no orders are created yet. When the order batch is in `complete` status, all orders are created and available.

from_name.description: The name of the sender. This is displayed on the order and notifications.

message.description: The message in this order batch, provided by the sender.

orders_count.description: The total number of orders in this order batch. This might be blank if the order batch is scheduled for the future, or it could be fewer than the recipient count if the order batch is in the process of being sent.

orders_preview.description: A preview of the first 10 orders in this order batch. To paginate through all of the orders, use the `/order_batches/:id/orders` endpoint with `?page&per_page`. If your use case never sends more than 10 orders in a single batch, you can use this field instead of calling `/order_batches/:id/orders`. For order batches with more than 10 recipients, this array will be empty while the orders are asynchronously created in the background.

recipients_count.description: The total number of recipients in this order batch.

recipients_preview.description: A preview of the first 10 recipients in this order batch. To see all of the recipients, use `/order_batches/:id/recipients`. Recipients contain the original contact information provided for each recipient when the order batch was created.

cart.description: The cart that was sent for this order batch. This is the original cart that was created for this order batch. If individual orders were swapped, this still remains the same, whereas orders' `cart` would change if they were swapped.

is_scheduled_send.description: Whether this order batch was set up as a scheduled send. This stays as `true` after the scheduled send is complete. To determine if the order batch is scheduled to be sent for the future, check if `status` is `pending` and `scheduled_send_on` is in the future. When a order batch is scheduled, orders are only created on the scheduled send date.

scheduled_send_on.description: The date and time the order batch is scheduled to be sent. This will be `null` if the order batch is not a scheduled send. This field remains after the scheduled send completes. ISO 8601, UTC.

expires_at.description: The date and time the order batch is set to expire. ISO 8601, UTC.

batch_name.description: An internal name for the order batch, falling back to an auto-generated batch name. Not displayed to recipients.

card_id.description: The digital greeting card on this order batch.

sender.description: The sender of the order batch.

workspace_id.description: Organizations are sub-divided into workspaces. Order batches are contained in workspaces, identified by this ID.

reference_id.description: The reference ID displayed on receipts and other locations as the ID for this order batch.

customer_reference_id.description: A unique client-supplied reference for this order batch, provided on creation to prevent duplicate order batches. Returns the value sent when the batch was created, or `null` if none was provided.

gift_link_url.description: The shareable gift link for `link_*` / `email_and_link` sends, surfaced from the first gift in the batch. Null for `direct_send` (no shareable link) and before the shared link exists (e.g. large asynchronous sends while gifts are still being created).

created_at.description: When the order batch was created. ISO 8601, UTC.

product_thumbnail_url.description: A thumbnail image URL for the first product in the batch's cart, suitable for list rows. Null when the product has no images.

Order.description: An individual order contains the gift link to be sent to the recipient (if applicable) and other information about the order.

individual_gift_link.description: This gift link can be sent to the recipient or shared with the sender. For privacy reasons, this gift link does not display tracking information. A separate link, the recipient link, is sent directly to the recipient after they accept their gift, which does contain tracking information.

cart.description: The cart currently on this order. If the order is a gift that was swapped, `cart` displays the most recent products selected (i.e. post-swap).

cart_selections.description: Product variant selections for each cart product. Only for commerce app orders.

shipments.description: A list of the shipments for the order.

workspace_id.description: Organizations are sub-divided into workspaces. Orders are contained in workspaces, identified by this ID.

expires_at.description: For gifts, the date and time the gift is set to expire.

card_id.description: The digital greeting card on this gift.

message.description: The message in this gift, provided by the sender.

thank_you_note.description: A thank you note sent by the recipient.

question.description: The question text as shown to the recipient when they accepted.

answer.description: The recipient's answer. For multiple-select questions, the selected options are joined with "; ".

form_responses.description: Recipient answers to the custom form attached to this gift. Only present when the recipient submitted at least one answer.

view_count_recipient.description: The number of times the recipient viewed the gift.

is_swapped.description: If this gift was swapped by the recipient. Swapping allows a recipient to select another product or products, which replaces the `cart`. The original products are saved to `original_cart`.

order_batch_id.description: On Goody for Business, all orders are attached to a order batch, which is a collection of one or more orders.

amounts.description: Costs in USD cents (i.e. $1.00 = 100). If the order was swapped, `amounts` displays the most recent amounts (i.e. post-swap).

amount_product.description: Total cost of the products in this order.

amount_shipping.description: Total cost of shipping for this order.

amount_processing_fee.description: Total cost of processing fees for this order.

amount_credit_applied.description: Total amount of credit applied to this order.

amount_pre_tax_total.description: Total cost of the products, shipping, and processing fees in this order.

amount_total.description: Total cost of the products, shipping, processing fees, tax, and global shipping costs in this order.

amount_global_relay_cost.description: Total cost of global shipping for this order through the Global Relay service.

event_times.description: Only provided when calling the /orders/:id endpoint.

notified_at.description: When the recipient was notified of the order.

opened_at.description: For gifts, when the recipient opened the order.

accepted_at.description: For gifts, when the recipient accepted the order.

pending_payment_at.description: When the order entered pending payment status.

paid_at.description: When the order was paid for.

shipped_at.description: When the order was first shipped. If there are multiple shipments, this is when the first shipment shipped.

delivered_at.description: When the order was delivered. If there are multiple shipments, this is when all shipments were delivered.

original_cart.description: If this order is a gift that was swapped, this displays the original cart that was sent to the recipient.

original_amounts.description: If this order is a gift that was swapped, this displays the original amounts of the cart that was sent to the recipient.

sender.description: The Goody user who sent this order.

payment_link.description: For commerce apps using Hosted Payment, the payment link for the gift with the credit card entry form. Available when the gift is in `pending_payment` status (after it has been accepted).

reference_id.description: The reference ID displayed on receipts and other locations as the ID for this order.

brand.description: The brand that this product is from.

price.description: Catalog price in USD cents. Only present on `/order_batches?cloneable=true` listings.

cart_eligible.description: Whether this product can share a cart with other products. Only present on `/order_batches?cloneable=true` listings.

is_collection.description: Whether this product is a collection. Collections carry their own recipient-experience settings (multi-select, shipping), so batch-level swap and international options do not apply to them. Only present on `/order_batches?cloneable=true` listings.

image_url.description: A thumbnail image URL for the product. Only present on `/order_batches?cloneable=true` listings.

variants.description: The variants chosen by the sender for this line, if any. Only present on `/order_batches?cloneable=true` listings.

variable_price.description: For flex gifts and gift cards, the amount (in cents) the sender originally chose; `null` for fixed-price products. Only present on `/order_batches?cloneable=true` listings.

free_shipping.description: Whether this line item ships free on its own (per-item rule; lines from the same brand may still combine to reach a free-shipping minimum). Only present on `/order_batches?cloneable=true` listings.

CartSelection.description: Product variant selections for a specific gift cart product.

cart_item_id.description: The cart item ID this selection belongs to. Match this with cart.items[].id.

quantity_index.description: The index of this selection within multiple quantities of the same product. If a given cart product has multiple quantities, this will be 0 for the first unit, 1 for the second unit, etc.

variants.description: The selected variants for this product selection and quantity index.

OrderActivityStatus.description: The status of the order activity event. Mapped from internal statuses using the same logic as order status.

OrderActivity.description: An order activity represents a status change event for an order.

order_status.description: The status that the order transitioned to.

order.description: The current state of the order.

brand_name.description: The name of the brand that this shipment is from.

tracking_carrier.description: The carrier for this shipment, e.g. UPS.

delivery_eta.description: The estimated delivery time of this shipment.

subtitle_short.description: An optional one-line description of this product. When provided, it overrides the subtitle when displayed in areas with less space. Not always provided.

recipient_description.description: An optional description of this product with custom verbiage for recipients. When provided, it overrides the subtitle for the product when displayed to the recipient. Falls back to the subtitle.

variants_label.description: The label for the variants of this product, e.g. "Size" or "Color".

variants_num_selectable.description: The number of variants that can be selected for this product. For example, if this is a t-shirt, then this would be 1, since you can only select one size. If this were a build-a-box of chocolates, this could be 3 if you could select 3 flavor variants.

variant_groups.description: For products that have multiple types of variants, such as both Color and Size, this array contains each group and the options for each group. All variant group permutations have a variant generated for them, constructed from the options in the order of the groups, separated by ` / `, e.g. `Medium / Black` when the groups are Size and Color.

price.description: The price of the product, in cents.

price_is_variable.description: Whether the price of this product is variable. If true, then the price can be set by the sender.

price_min.description: The minimum price of the product, in cents. Only used if price_is_variable is true.

price_max.description: The maximum price of the product, in cents. Only used if price_is_variable is true.

items.description: The US states that this product cannot be shipped to.

cart_eligible.description: Whether this product can be combined with others in a single gift. False for products that must be sent on their own, such as gift cards, alcohol, custom stores, gift of choice, and collections.

attributes.description: An array of attributes that describe this product.

status.description: Whether this product is active. Since the product catalog only returns active products by default, this is always `true`, except if you are a Commerce API customer using a custom catalog, and are pulling products with the `custom_catalog_show_inactive` flag.

updated_at.description: The date and time this product was last updated, ISO 8601 format. This is bumped when the product, brand, product variants, product attributes, or product images are updated.

custom_price_tier.description: For approved API partners only. A custom price tier for this product.

gift_card.description: Present only for gift card products. Use to tell a gift card apart from a variable-price flex gift and to enforce its amount rules. All amounts here are in the card's native currency (the units a gift card's `variable_price` is spent in).

currency_rate.description: Native currency units per USD (native_amount / currency_rate = USD amount), for showing the USD a sender pays on a non-USD card. Always 1 for USD; null when the rate is temporarily unavailable, in which case treat the amount as native-only.

denominations.description: The fixed set of allowed amounts, in native-currency cents. Null when the gift card is a sliding scale, in which case use value_restrictions.

value_restrictions.description: For a sliding-scale gift card, the inclusive native-currency-cent bounds a sender may fund. Null for fixed-denomination cards (use denominations instead).

min.description: Minimum fundable amount, in native-currency cents.

max.description: Maximum fundable amount, in native-currency cents.

id.description: Product ID. Send it like any other product (as a cart item) with a `variable_price` in [price_min, price_max].

kind.description: `default` is the flagship Gift of Choice; `seasonal` is a curated/holiday one. Exactly one entry is `default`.

price_min.description: Lowest amount, in cents, the sender may fund.

price_max.description: Highest amount, in cents; null means unlimited (the usual case).

suggested_variable_price.description: Reserved for budget-framed queries; currently always null on this endpoint.

items.description: An occasion this Gift of Choice is recommended for.

logo_image.description: The logo image for this brand.

shipping_price.description: The price of shipping for this brand, in cents.

free_shipping_minimum.description: When set and when the product price is above this amount, shipping is free. In cents. Products in a cart for this brand can combine to reach this threshold.

commerce_revshare_excluded.description: Whether this brand is excluded from the commerce revenue share. Only displayed on the products endpoint when using a commerce app.

brand_values.description: An array of brand values for this brand. Potential values are USA Made, Social Impact Driven, Sustainable, Gluten Free, Vegan, Kosher Certified, Female Founded, AAPI Founded, BIPOC Founded, Black Founded, LGBTQ+ Founded, and Hispanic Founded.

subtitle.description: A short marketing description of the brand. Only included when using the brands endpoint.

tile_image.description: The square tile image for this brand. Only included when using the brands endpoint.

header_image.description: The wide header image for this brand. Only included when using the brands endpoint.

price_min.description: The lowest product price among this brand's listed products, in cents. Only included when using the brands endpoint.

brand_sets.description: An array of brand sets for this brand. Only included when using the brands endpoint.

Category.description: A storefront category, usable as a products filter. A category can appear in the store's "Categories" navigation, its "Occasions" navigation, both, or neither.

icon.description: URL of the category's SVG icon.

categories_set.description: Whether this category appears in the "Categories" navigation set.

occasions_set.description: Whether this category appears in the "Occasions" navigation set.

is_featured.description: Whether this is the store's default landing category.

ShippingCountry.description: A country Goody can ship to, with the shipping groups it belongs to. Countries in the "domestic" group support the domestic-only product filter.

groups.description: The shipping groups this country belongs to.

BrandSet.description: A brand set represents a collection of products from a brand.

images.description: An array of images for this brand set.

products.description: An array of products in this brand set.

categories.description: An array of categories this brand set belongs to.

subcategories.description: An array of subcategory names within this category.

name.description: The name of the variant group, e.g. "Size" or "Color".
The name of the variant group option, e.g. "Small" for the "Size" variant group.

color.description: The hex color code for this option, e.g. "#000000", if any.

label.description: The label for this attribute, e.g. "Materials".

content.description: The content for this attribute, e.g. "80% cotton, 20% elastane". This can be text or sanitized HTML (you might choose to sanitize the HTML as well). Allowed elements are a (href allowed), div, img (src, width height, alt allowed), span, p, br, strong, b, em, i, ol, ul, li, and hr.

ProductCartSummary.description: A compact product shape for products that ride along as a ready-made cart line (such as the product representing a collection): just enough to add it to a cart and render the row.

id.description: Product ID — send it as a cart item like any other product.

price.description: The price of the product, in cents.

cart_eligible.description: Whether this product can be combined with others in a single gift. False for collections, which are always sent on their own.

is_collection.description: Whether this product is a collection. Collections carry their own recipient-experience settings (multi-select, shipping), so batch-level swap and international options do not apply to them.

image_url.description: A thumbnail image URL for the product.

Collection.description: A collection is a curated group of products that recipients can select from.

is_published.description: Indicates whether the collection currently has a published version.

published_price.description: Price for the published collection in cents, including shipping.

products_count.description: Number of products in the published version. Null for unpublished collections.

product.description: The product that represents the collection when published. Null for unpublished collections. To send this collection, send the product ID in the cart

published_version.description: Details about the published version of this collection. Null for unpublished collections.

CollectionVersion.description: Details about a version of a collection.

multiple_select_mode.description: Controls how many items recipients can select from the collection.

multiple_select_count.description: When multiple_select_mode is item_count, the number of items recipients may choose.

multiple_select_price.description: When multiple_select_mode is max_price, the spending limit in cents.

international_shipping_tier.description: Shipping tier applied to the collection (e.g. standard, full).

international_gift_cards_enabled.description: Whether international gift cards are available when swapping products.

collection_categories.description: Categories and their products included in this version, ordered by position.

CollectionCategory.description: A category of products within a collection version. All products are assigned a category.

is_featured.description: Whether this category is considered the "featured" category.

collection_products.description: Products assigned to this category in their display order.

CollectionProduct.description: Represents a product that can be selected within a collection.

country.description: The two-letter country code, e.g. "US". Only US is supported at this time.

name.description: The user's display name, prefilled into a gift's From field. Present for user tokens; null when unset.

can_send_smart_links.description: Whether this user can create Smart Links (the "Gift link" send). Present for user tokens.

can_find_emails.description: Whether this user can use the LinkedIn email lookup (a Goody Pro feature). Present for user tokens.

cardholder_name.description: For payment methods with a cardholder name, returns the name on the card.

balance.description: For payment methods with a balance, returns the available balance on the payment method.

image.description: The image URL for this card. Typically 800x1130.

image_thumb.description: The thumbnail image URL for this card. Typically 200x283.

occasions.description: An array of occasions that this card is relevant for.

name.description: A human-facing label for the template.

shared.description: Whether the template was shared with the user by someone else (vs. owned by the user). Always false today, since templates are Goody-curated and available to everyone.

card_id.description: The greeting card attached to the template, if any.

card_image_url.description: The URL of the template's greeting card image, if any.

product_summary.description: A comma-separated summary of the products in the template.

product_thumbnail_urls.description: Thumbnail image URLs for up to 4 of the template's products, for collage-style previews. Products without images are skipped.

product_count.description: The total number of products in the template (may exceed the number of thumbnails).

price_product.description: The products subtotal in USD cents a sender pays for this template, before shipping, fees, and tax. Uses the stored flex-gift/gift-card amount where one applies. Null when a component price is unknown.

free_shipping.description: Whether every product in the template ships free (the brand ships everything free, or the item's price clears the brand's free-shipping minimum).

OrderBatchInput.description: Input parameters for an order batch.

from_name.description: The name of the sender of the order (typically a gift), to be displayed as "from".

message.description: For gifts, a message for the gift to be displayed in the digital unwrapping and email notifications, if enabled.

card_id.description: The digital greeting card to attach to gifts. A card must be specified if a message is specified, since the message is displayed after the card is opened.

custom_form_id.description: Optional. An existing custom form (a set of question fields recipients answer when they accept) to attach to gifts. Must be a form you own or one shared with the workspace. This does not create new questions, and is ignored for the `direct_send` send method.

payment_method_id.description: The payment method used to pay for this order batch. If not specified, defaults to the first payment method on the account. If the account has no payment methods, then the order batch creation will fail.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to create the order batch in. If not specified, creates the order batch in the oldest workspace the user has access to.

scheduled_send_on.description: The date and time at which the order batch will be sent. If not specified, the order batch is sent immediately. If an order batch is scheduled to be sent in the future, then orders will not be created until the scheduled send time. ISO 8601 format.

expires_at.description: The date and time at which the order batch will expire. If not specified, the order batch does not expire. An expiry must be set for orders paid using account balance. ISO 8601 format.

international_gift_cards_enabled.description: Whether to enable international gift cards on this order. If `true` and the `international_shipping_tier` is `standard`, then international gift cards can be swapped to. If `false`, then international gift cards are not available to be swapped to.

allow_recipient_topup.description: Whether recipients can pay to upgrade their gift. If `true` and `swap` is `multiple`, recipients see gift prices when swapping and can pay the difference to choose a more expensive item. If `false` (default), recipients can only swap to items at or below the gift's value.

notifications_enabled.description: Direct Send only. Whether to enable notifications for Direct Send orders. If `true`, we send confirmation and shipping notifications to Direct Send recipients. If `false`, we do not send any notifications to Direct Send recipients.

commerce_end_user_id.description: If associating this gift with a Commerce End User (i.e. your app's user), provide the user ID here. Required if using a Commerce User Payment Method in the `payment_method_id` field.

customer_reference_id.description: A unique, client-supplied identifier for this order batch, which can be used as an idempotency key to prevent duplicate creation. If an order batch with the same `customer_reference_id` already exists for your account, the request is rejected with an error instead of creating a duplicate. Returned on the order batch as `customer_reference_id`.

custom_price_tier.description: For approved API partners only. A custom price tier to set on this order batch.

product_id.description: ID of the product. Preferred over URL since this is always stable. Either `product_id` or `product_url` must be provided.

product_url.description: URL of the product. Either `product_id` or `product_url` must be provided.

variable_price.description: If this product has a variable price (e.g. a flex gift or a gift card), then this must be provided. A positive integer represented in cents.

variants.description: An array of variant names (not IDs). When using the Direct Send send method with a product with variants, the variants must be provided. The length of the array must be equal to `variants_num_selectable` on the product, and the variants must come from the names of the `varaints` on the product. For example, for a t-shirt with `variants_num_selectable` = 1 and variants S, M, L, pass ['M']. Or, for a box of cookies with `variants_num_selectable` = 2 and variants Sugar, Caramel, Chocolate, pass ['Sugar', 'Chocolate'].

OrderBatchSendMethod.description: The method for sending a order batch. `email_and_link` sends a gift email to the recipient (specify `email` for each recipient). `link_multiple_custom_list` generates a gift link without an automatic email. `direct_send` ships the product directly to the recipient (specify `mailing_address` for each recipient). For more information, see [Send Methods](/introduction/send-methods).

OrderBatchSwap.description: What method to use to allow recipients to swap their gift. `single` (default) allows the recipient to swap the gift for one item, with hidden gift prices. `multiple` allows them to swap for multiple items up to the gift cost, with gift prices shown. `disabled` disables swapping on the gift. For gift collections (gift of choice), this must not be `disabled`.

OrderBatchInternationalShippingTier.description: Whether to enable international shipping on this order. `disabled` (default) only enables US shipping on this order. `standard` combined with `international_gift_cards_enabled` enables international gift cards. `full` enables the full global catalog for 100+ countries, with additional tax, duties, and freight costs.

phone.description: Optional. Phone number for text notifications. E164 format (e.g. +15552347890), US only.

mailing_address.description: Optional mailing address to pre-populate into the order. This field is only available for approved API partners.

WebhookInput.description: Input parameters for a webhook endpoint.

url.description: The URL for the webhook to call.

events.description: Filter the events you want to get webhooks for. Refer to the Webhooks list for the event names.

OrderBatchPriceInput.description: Input parameters for an order batch price calculation.

OrderBatchPrice.description: The price for an order batch (all in cents).

OrderBatchPriceCart.description: Prices for a single recipient's cart in cents. This represents the price for each recipient in the order batch.

OrderBatchPriceTotal.description: Total price estimates for the entire order batch in cents. This includes all recipients.

recipients.description: Number of recipients in the batch

est_tax_calculated.description: Direct send: calculated tax estimate when addresses are provided

est_total_calculated.description: Calculated total estimate when addresses are provided

commerce_end_user_id.description: The user ID of the user in *your* app to associate this payment method with.

payment_method_type.description: The type of payment method to create. Currently, only `card` is supported.

interim_card_key.description: The key for the interim card to use for the payment method.

card_brand.description: Brand of the card, e.g. 'Visa' or 'Mastercard'.

card_last_4.description: Last 4 digits of the card number.

created_at.description: Date and time the payment method was created, ISO 8601 format.
